about: Ground cover for the medium/high tiers (tools/blender/make-cover-atlas.py, make-cover.py). Each file holds one node per kind, all at the origin (instance sources). Units metres, +Y up.

grass_tufts.gltf.note: three crossed cards each, normals straight up (lit like the ground), roots darkened by COLOR_0; colour matched to grass_meadow's mean

flowers.gltf.note: white daisy-like, yellow (celandine), violet-blue; three crossed cards, up normals

pebbles.gltf.note: vertex-coloured stones, 320 triangles each, no texture
